Set-Location -LiteralPath $app
git pull --ff-only 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 3
"=== ENV (session) ==="
$env:JAVA_HOME = "C:\Program Files\Android\Android Studio\jbr"
$env:ANDROID_HOME = "C:\Users\Abdullah G\Desktop\Website\flip-scanner\Android\Sdk"
$env:ANDROID_SDK_ROOT = $env:ANDROID_HOME
"=== LOCAL.PROPERTIES ==="
"sdk.dir=C:\\Users\\Abdullah G\\Desktop\\Website\\flip-scanner\\Android\\Sdk" | Set-Content (Join-Path $app "android\local.properties") -Encoding UTF8
"written"
"=== GRADLE DOWNLOAD ==="
$tools = "C:\Users\Abdullah G\Desktop\Website\flip-scanner\tools"
if(-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $tools "gradle-8.10.2\bin\gradle.bat"))){
  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $tools | Out-Null
  $gz = Join-Path $tools "gradle-8.10.2-bin.zip"
  Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://services.gradle.org/distributions/gradle-8.10.2-bin.zip" -OutFile $gz
  Expand-Archive -LiteralPath $gz -DestinationPath $tools -Force
  Remove-Item $gz -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  "gradle downloaded+extracted"
} else { "gradle already present" }
"=== WRAPPER ==="
Set-Location (Join-Path $app "android")
& (Join-Path $tools "gradle-8.10.2\bin\gradle.bat") wrapper --gradle-version 8.10.2 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 4
"=== WRAPPER FILES ==="
Get-ChildItem "gradlew*" | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name
Get-ChildItem "gradle\wrapper" | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name
